title: Pehlu Shikishta Bibi
body:
Pehlu shikishta bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
Thamey huwe asa ko majlis me aarahi hai pehlu shikishta bibi
14 Sadi se abtak aansu baha rahi hai pehlu shikishta bibi
1.Touheed ko bachane rab ki riza ko paane
Karbobala basane
Jo raha hai kaunba ab saath jarahi hai
<<MINI>>
Pehlu shikishta bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Joh tha safir e Sarwar dhooke se ghar bulaker
Maare use sitamger
Koofe ki har gali me matam bana rahi hai
<<MINI>>
Pehlu shikishta bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Kubra huwi hai bewa maara gaya hai dulha
Rounda gaya hai lasha
Sheh chun rahe hai tukdre aansu baha rahi hai
<<MINI>>
Pehlu shikishta bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Baazu kata ke safdar girta hai ab zameen per
Koi nahi hai Yawar
Nehre furat per yeh nouha suna rahi hai
<<MINI>>
Pehlu shikishta bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Nazre dhuwa dhuwa hai yeh sadmaye jawaa’n
Kya saqt imtehaa’n hai
Sarwar ke sath milker lasha utha rahi hai
<<MINI>>
Pehlu shikishta bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Teer e sitam chala hai hulqoom chid gaya hai
Yeh zulm e narawaa’n hai
Sadme se khoon ke ab aansu baha rahi hai
<<MINI>>
Pehlu shikishta bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Pyaas e pe yeh jafa sukha huwa gala hai
Khanjar se kat raha hai
Karbobala me aakar aansu baha rahi hai
<<MINI>>
Pehlu shikishta bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
8.Gusl o kafan bhi sheh ko de kis tarah se bolo
Qaidi bana hai dekho
Potey ki bekasi per matam mana rahi hai
<<MINI>>
Pehlu shikishta bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
9.Ghar lutgaya hai sheh ka qaidi bana hai kunba
Jouhar ka hai yeh nouha
Mohsin ke baad ab tak sadma utha rahi hai
<<MINI>>
Pehlu shikishta bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
Azz... Jawad Ali jouhar
